mods.author: Simulatte
mods.description: Replaces the broken skybox in the library.
mods.name: Library skybox fix

mods.author: Simulatte
mods.description: Adds the data for the 9 ported PSP Rival Swords bonus maps (Water, Sand, Lava, Vaults, Sanctuaries). Requires the "Rival Swords" code patch (Code mods tab) to add engine patches and the main-menu entry that loads these maps. Requires separate audio files (not included).
mods.name: Rival Swords bonus maps (PSP port)

mods.author: Simulatte
mods.description: Adds a true bleeding effect to every sand creature. v2.0 also covers enemies baked directly into level bins (rooftops, minaret, courtyard, towers, caves, and more) that spawn without going through their actor bin, which the first version left dry.
mods.name: Blood for sand enemies

mods.author: Simulatte
mods.description: Adds the data for the ported Xbox bonus maps: Waterfront Tower and Grotto of Trials to Warrior Within. Requires the "Xbox DLCs PC port" code patch (Code mods tab) to add the DLC menu and load these maps.
mods.name: Xbox DLC maps (Waterfront Tower + Grotto of Trials)

mods.author: Simulatte

mods.name: Spider-Man as the Prince

mods.author: Simulatte
mods.description: Restores Prince's teeth to how they looked in the demo.
mods.name: Prince teeth fix

mods.author: Simulatte
mods.description: Relocates the problematic springboard in the Tower to make the Prince's jump reach the dagger plate.
mods.name: Tower Springboard Fix

mods.author: Simulatte
mods.description: Fixes the Prince being offset to the side of the enemy during the weapon steal finisher. Relocates the problematic springboard in the Tower to make the Prince's jump reach the dagger plate. Fixes flickering fire/smoke FX, disappearing objects, floating debris, and the backdrop plane being drawn over FX in the intro areas. Fixes black lines on the backdrop.
mods.name: The Two Thrones Essential Fixes

mods.author: Simulatte
mods.description: Fixes the missing audio in the "A helping hand" hourglass chamber cutscene and crowmaster's crow flight animation. Replaces the broken skybox in the library. Restores Prince's teeth to how they looked in the demo.
mods.name: Warrior Within Essential Fixes

mods.author: Simulatte
mods.description: Fixes broken UVs in the Final Shape Prince model.
mods.name: Prince Bare UVs fix
